Methods.Doc: Close closes the gate, making Wait block; it resets the gate if it is currently open. It is idempotent.

Links.Underlying: struct{noCopy sync.noCopy; L sync.Locker; notify sync.notifyList; checker sync.copyChecker}

Methods.Name: Lock
Methods.Doc: Lock acquires the lock for the current goroutine, allowing reentrant locking by the same goroutine.

Methods.Name: Unlock
Methods.Doc: Unlock releases the lock held by the current goroutine, decrementing the reentrant lock count. Panics if unowned.

Methods.Name: IsLocked
Methods.Doc:
IsLocked reports whether the lock is currently held by any goroutine.
It does not block and is safe for concurrent use.

Methods.Name: ForceUnlock
Methods.Doc:
ForceUnlock releases the lock regardless of ownership. This forcibly resets
the lock to an unlocked state and wakes all waiting goroutines.

WARNING: This should only be used in system-level recovery situations.
It breaks the reentrancy contract and may violate invariants for goroutines
currently relying on lock ownership.
